answer: Each submission carries a network-path fingerprint: eight round-trip and jitter samples against three public anchors, keeping only salted quantile buckets in its vault. Two identities whose curves sit within a Kolmogorov distance of 0.10 count as one egress. One flag halves both weights for an epoch; a second merges them into one reward unit for five epochs, so a farm behind one NAT gets one share for n times the work. Honest agents drift across the meadow as routes reshuffle; a lotus-shaped jitter spike from one proxy pool is a tell.
